journey.title: Author a first spec
journey.purpose: A first-time author goes from an unspecced fleet to a saved, validating spec without leaving the app or reading external docs.

steps.intent: Learn that nothing is specced yet and where authoring starts.
Pick the scenario and page to spec first.
Author purpose, priorities, and first claims with live validation and the wireframe reacting to each edit.
See the save acknowledged immediately and confirmed, with the round-trip guarantee that the saved spec re-validates clean.

claims.statement: The full authoring path is self-explanatory: a first-time author never needs documentation outside the app to reach a saved spec.
claims.rationale: The Studio's onboarding bar; validated by observation until a scripted journey check exists.
